question: Should OpenClaw ship this bundled 1Password SecretRef provider, including its exact-head `@openclaw/fs-safe` dependency change and service-account-token-to-`op` execution boundary?
rationale: The existing SecretRef contract and the Vault sibling establish a plausible owner boundary, but accepting a new bundled provider that invokes an external executable with credentials is a maintainer security and product-scope decision, not a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve with live proof
options.body: Authorize the exact dependency graph and accept the bundled provider after a redacted real Gateway proof confirms setup, apply/audit, and credential consumption through the trusted `op` CLI.

options.title: Keep manual exec setup
options.body: Decline the bundled integration and retain the existing generic exec-provider path for operators who need 1Password-backed SecretRefs.
